criteria.description: Given a task selected on the DEVX-040 board, the screen lists every file under docs/planning/evidence/ whose name starts with that task's ID (case-insensitive prefix match on <ID>-), with file type and size.
.png/.jpg/.jpeg evidence files render as an inline thumbnail, openable full-size in-app
.md/.json evidence files open in-app using file-preview mechanism

If a task's own Acceptance or Handoff text contains the phrase 'hands-on evidence' but no matching evidence file exists under docs/planning/evidence/, the board flags that task ('evidence claimed, file not found')
Hands-on evidence: screenshot/verification showing real image thumbnails and claimed but missing flags
